description: Defines IPC protocol structures and constants for crash reporting in Windows environment, including message tags, custom info entries, and the ProtocolMessage structure used for communication between crash client and server.

classes.name: CustomInfoEntry
classes.description: Represents a name/value pair for custom client information in crash reports.

classes.name: CustomClientInfo
classes.description: Holds an array of CustomInfoEntry and its count for custom client data.

classes.name: ProtocolMessage
classes.description: Represents an IPC message structure for communication between crash client and server, including message type, identifiers, dump info, and synchronization handles.

methods.name: CustomInfoEntry()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing name and value to empty.

methods.name: CustomInfoEntry(const wchar_t*, const wchar_t*)
methods.description: Constructor initializing name and value with provided strings.

methods.name: set_name
methods.description: Sets the name field, copying from a wchar_t string.

methods.name: set_value
methods.description: Sets the value field, copying from a wchar_t string.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets both name and value fields.

methods.name: ProtocolMessage(...)
methods.description: Constructor initializing all fields with provided parameters.
